note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to thickened painful nails. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Exam: nails examined consistent with thickened painful nails. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.

Procedure: Debridement of 1 to 5 thickened nails performed with sterile technique. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
